_note: Generic definitions written from general knowledge, NOT from the labeled rows, to avoid leaking answers.

kaggle.Paycheck: Salary or wages deposited by an employer.
kaggle.Credit Card Payment: Payments moving money from checking to a credit card, or the matching credit on the card. Not purchases.
kaggle.Mortgage & Rent: Monthly mortgage or rent for your home.
kaggle.Utilities: Household utility bills: electricity, natural gas (e.g. a 'gas company' bill), water, sewage, trash. NOT car fuel.
kaggle.Television: Cable/satellite TV and streaming TV or video subscriptions.
kaggle.Movies & Dvds: Cinema/movie theater tickets and buying or renting individual movies.
kaggle.Entertainment: Other leisure such as concerts, events, games. Use only if no more specific entertainment category fits.
kaggle.Restaurants: Sit-down restaurants, diners, delis, taverns and pubs where you mainly eat a meal.
kaggle.Fast Food: Quick-service chains and takeaway such as burgers, pizza delivery, tacos.
kaggle.Alcohol & Bars: Bars, breweries and liquor stores where the purchase is mainly drinks.
kaggle.Food & Dining: Generic food spending. Use ONLY if none of Restaurants, Fast Food, Coffee Shops, Alcohol & Bars or Groceries fits.
kaggle.Gas & Fuel: Fuel for a vehicle at a gas/petrol station. NOT a household gas utility bill.
kaggle.Shopping: General retail and online shopping (clothes, household items, marketplaces).
kaggle.Electronics & Software: Electronics stores, devices, software and app purchases.
kaggle.Home Improvement: Hardware and home improvement stores, DIY supplies, repairs.

ing.Income: Salary, tax refunds and other income.
ing.Utilities: Energy, water, internet/TV and mobile phone bills.
ing.Insurance: Health insurance and other insurance premiums.
ing.Subscriptions: Recurring digital services like video/music streaming and cloud storage.
ing.Eating Out: Restaurants, cafes, coffee, bars and food delivery.
ing.Transport: Public transport, fuel, bike or car subscriptions.
ing.Shopping: Retail and online shopping, including refunds of purchases.
ing.Savings: Transfers to your own savings account.
ing.Transfers: Payments to/from friends (e.g. Tikkie) that are not income.
ing.Other: Anything that fits no other category, e.g. travel.
